title: Payroll & Contracts
responsibility: Statutory deductions (social insurance, income tax) follow your tax accountant's payroll register. Amounts PlanQ pre-fills are estimates for comparison.

people.empty: No one on payroll yet. Pick a member or add a freelancer to start.

create.title: Add person
create.noCandidates: Every member is already on payroll.

detail.bankSet: An account is registered (press Show to see the number — viewing is logged).
detail.contractsEmpty: No contracts yet. Start with Add contract.
detail.deleteHint: Only possible when there are no contracts. Otherwise set the status to Left.
detail.deleteConfirmMsg: {{name}} will be removed from payroll. This can't be undone.
detail.readOnlyPlan: Your plan allows viewing only (editing needs Pro or above).
detail.bankRemoveMsg: The registered payment account will be removed. You will need to enter it again to use it.

contract.activateHint: Making this contract active ends any overlapping earlier contract the day before it starts.
contract.deleteDraftMsg: This draft contract will be deleted. This can't be undone.

contractCreate.title: Add contract
contractCreate.hint: Save as a draft, then press Make active to use it for payroll and labor cost. Create the contract document from the Employment Contract template in Q docs and collect signatures there.

error.overlapping_contract: An active contract already starts on or after this date.
error.end_date_required: Fixed-term contracts need an end date.
error.end_before_start: The end date is before the start date.
error.contract_locked: Amounts and dates of active or ended contracts can't change. Add a new contract.
error.employee_no_taken: That employee number is already used.
error.person_exists: This member is already on payroll.
error.person_has_contracts: This person has contracts. Set the status to Left instead.
error.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
error.run_exists: A run for this month already exists. Edit it or create an adjustment run.
error.run_locked: A confirmed run can't be edited.
error.negative_net: Someone has a negative net pay.
error.no_entries: This run has nobody in it.
error.rate_cycle: Rate items can't use each other as their base.
error.item_locked: This item is used by a confirmed run — earning/deduction, sign, totals and taxable can't change (the name can).
error.item_in_use: Used items can't be deleted. Turn off «Active».
error.item_in_contracts: This item is used in contract lines, so it must stay «Fixed».
error.base_item_locked: Base pay is the basis for unpaid leave and can't be changed or deleted.
error.unpaid_leave_must_be_deduction: Unpaid leave must be a deduction.
error.invalid_rate_base: Pick the base for the rate.
error.header_not_found: Couldn't find the header row (name, base pay, net pay…) in the register.
error.pdf_no_text: This PDF has no text (scanned files can't be read yet).
error.ai_unavailable: AI is unavailable, so the PDF couldn't be read. Please upload Excel or CSV.
error.ai_bad_output: Couldn't turn the PDF into a table. Please upload Excel or CSV.
error.no_rows: No person rows found in the register.
error.cue_quota_exceeded: This month's AI quota is used up.
error.adjustment_open: An unconfirmed adjustment run already exists. Finish it first.
error.only_draft_deletable: Only draft runs can be deleted.
error.invalid_transfer_assignee: Only payroll managers can handle transfers.
error.payslip_forbidden: You can only see your own payslips.
error.payroll_forbidden: Only payroll managers (owner and designated managers) can see this.

modules.sectionDesc: Choose which features this workspace uses. Turned-off features disappear from menus, screens and notifications; records are kept.
modules.payrollDesc: Contract history for staff and freelancers, monthly payroll, and reconciliation with your accountant's register (rolling out in stages).
modules.ownerOnly: Only the owner can change this.
modules.offConfirmMsg: The payroll menu and contract history will be hidden. Records are kept and come back when you turn it on again. Labor cost in profitability falls back to member rate settings.
modules.planRequired: Available on the Pro plan (or during a trial).

managers.title: Payroll managers
managers.desc: Members besides the owner who can view and manage payroll and contracts. Workspace admins can't see payroll unless named here.
managers.ownerOnly: Only the owner can assign managers.

runs.empty: No payroll runs yet. Use [This month] to draft this month — everyone with an active contract is added.

create.title: New payroll run
create.payDateHint: Leave empty to use the contracts' pay day (or month end).
create.hint: Fills a draft with everyone who has an active contract this month. Statutory deductions stay empty until you import your accountant's register.

run.title: {{period}} payroll
run.locked: A confirmed run can't be edited. Create an adjustment run for changes (the original stays as is).
run.unresolved: {{n}} blank cell(s) — adopt register values or enter them to confirm.
run.empty: Nobody has an active contract this month. Activate a contract in People, then press [Rebuild draft].
run.tasksCreated: Created {{n}} transfer to-do(s) (private · confidential · no account numbers).
run.tasksFailed: Confirmed, but transfer to-dos couldn't be created. Use ⋯ › [Recreate transfer to-dos].
run.adjOf: Adjustment to {{period}} — enter differences only (negative allowed).

confirmDialog.title: Confirm payroll?
confirmDialog.message: {{n}} people · total net pay {{net}} · {{tasks}} transfer to-do(s) will be created. Employees with an account get an in-app payslip notice (no email). A confirmed run cannot be edited.

paidDialog.title: Mark as paid?
paidDialog.messageOpen: {{n}} transfer to-do(s) are still open. Mark this run as paid anyway?

deleteDialog.title: Delete this draft?
deleteDialog.message: The {{period}} draft and everything entered in it will be deleted. This cannot be undone.

adjustDialog.title: Create an adjustment run?
adjustDialog.message: Creates adjustment run {{n}} for {{period}}. The original stays unchanged; enter only the differences.

rebuildDialog.title: Rebuild the draft?
rebuildDialog.message: Re-reads contracts and unpaid leave. Cells you edited and register values are kept.

entry.removeMsg: {{name}} will be removed from this run. [Rebuild draft] adds them back.

warn.gross_mismatch: The register's gross ({{statement}}) differs from the recomputed sum ({{recomputed}}).
warn.deduction_mismatch: The register's total deductions ({{statement}}) differ from the recomputed sum ({{recomputed}}).
warn.net_mismatch: The register's net pay ({{statement}}) differs from the recomputed value ({{recomputed}}).

statement.title: Accountant's payroll register
statement.hint: .xlsx and .csv are read as-is; only .pdf goes through AI (resident and account numbers are masked first). The file stays in Q file as private · confidential.
statement.droppedSecret: {{n}} ID/account column(s) were not read or stored.
statement.allMatched: Every person and column is matched.

items.empty: No items yet. Start with [Load template].
items.statutoryHint: PlanQ doesn't calculate statutory items (social insurance, income tax) — your accountant's register is the reference. Entering a rate only shows an estimate for comparison.
items.deleteMsg: Deletes "{{name}}". Only items never used can be deleted (turn off «Active» for used ones).

presetModal.title: Load template
presetModal.hint: Templates hold item names, types and calculation methods only — no rates.

suggestModal.title: Suggest with AI
suggestModal.hint: Only the country and type are sent (no people or amounts). Rates are never suggested; statutory deductions are set to «External (register)». Only what you pick is added.
suggestModal.fallback: AI is unavailable — showing the generic template.
